build_kernel_ridge_regression: build a kernel ridge regression model with RBF kernel and GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning
build_svr_regression: build a support vector regression model with RBF kernel and GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning
compare_training_times: compare training and prediction times between kernel ridge regression and SVR models
plot_regression_results: plot SVR and KRR fitted curves with support vectors and training data on a scatter plot
generate_learning_curves: generate learning curves for SVR and KRR using LearningCurveDisplay to compare model performance
